title: Enter the Month With One Priority
teaser: The first day of a new month does not require starting everything at once.
full_text: Write down the single outcome that matters most for May and keep the first week simple enough to support it.

title: Lower the Threshold for Starting
teaser: If beginning feels difficult, the task may be defined too broadly.
full_text: Reduce one delayed task to a first step that can be done in ten minutes. Aim only to complete that step today.

title: Protect an Empty Space in Your Calendar
teaser: Open time does not have to be filled the moment it appears.
full_text: Leave one short gap in your calendar unassigned today. Use it as breathing room for delays, recovery, or a quieter transition.

title: Compare a Purchase With Past Use
teaser: Your previous behavior can be a useful guide for a new buying decision.
full_text: Before buying something similar to what you already own, check how much you actually used the older item. Let that fact influence the decision.

title: Define the Purpose of a Conversation First
teaser: Conversations drift easily when the goal is unclear.
full_text: Before an important discussion today, write one sentence describing what you want clarified. Return to that sentence before the conversation ends.

title: Clarify Who Owns the Next Step
teaser: Shared work slows down when responsibility is vague.
full_text: In one collaborative task today, identify who owns the next action and who makes the final decision.

title: Measure One Screen Habit
teaser: Seeing actual usage is more useful than guessing it.
full_text: Check the real screen-time data for the app you use most. If you want to reduce it, set a limit for only one part of the day.

title: Simplify Before You Automate
teaser: Automating a complicated process can preserve unnecessary complexity.
full_text: Look at one repeated task and remove a needless step before considering automation. Automate only what still deserves to exist.

title: Turn a Promise Into a Calendar Entry
teaser: Intentions are easier to lose when they have no date.
full_text: Take one important promise you made to yourself or someone else and give it a specific time on your calendar.

title: Schedule Rest Before You Need It
teaser: Waiting until exhaustion is obvious can make recovery harder.
full_text: Choose a short rest period in advance today. Do not treat it as a reward you earn only after every task is complete.

title: Mark the Current Version of a Document
teaser: Similar filenames make it easy to work from the wrong copy.
full_text: Choose one frequently used document and clearly identify the current version. Archive or label older copies so the difference is obvious.

title: Ask How Reversible the Decision Is
teaser: Not every choice deserves the same amount of deliberation.
full_text: For one decision you are stuck on, ask how easily it can be reversed. If the cost of changing course is low, avoid treating it as permanent.

title: Define the Minimum Version of a Routine
teaser: A smaller version can preserve continuity on difficult days.
full_text: Choose one routine that matters to you and define the smallest version that still counts. Use that version when time or energy is limited.

title: Go Back to the Primary Source
teaser: Summaries can remove details that matter.
full_text: Find the original source behind one claim that affects a decision today. Check the surrounding context instead of relying only on a headline or quotation.

title: Review Your Energy at Midmonth
teaser: A plan is not working well if it finishes tasks by exhausting you.
full_text: Look at the first half of May and identify what took more energy than expected. Reduce one unnecessary demand for the rest of the month.

title: State a Boundary Before It Is Tested
teaser: Boundaries are easier to respect when they are communicated early.
full_text: For one upcoming situation, say briefly what you can and cannot commit to before the pressure arrives.

title: Move an Item to Where You Use It
teaser: The right environment can make a useful behavior easier.
full_text: Take one thing you often search for and move it to the place where you most often need it. Make that its permanent home.

title: Make One Goal Measurable
teaser: Vague goals make progress difficult to judge.
full_text: Add a number, date, or completion condition to one important goal today. Make it clear what evidence would show that you moved forward.

title: Do Not Confuse Sequence With Cause
teaser: Two events happening in order does not prove that one caused the other.
full_text: Examine one conclusion you made recently and list another plausible explanation. Do not treat the first story as the only one available.

title: Open a Backup Instead of Assuming It Works
teaser: A backup is useful only if it can actually be restored or opened.
full_text: Choose one important backup today and verify that the file opens and contains the version you expect.

title: Confirm an Expectation Instead of Guessing
teaser: Unspoken assumptions can create unnecessary work.
full_text: Before delivering one task today, confirm the expected scope in a short sentence, especially if timing, format, or detail level is unclear.

title: Calculate the Full Cost of a Purchase
teaser: The price tag may not represent the real total cost.
full_text: For one meaningful purchase, include maintenance, subscriptions, accessories, delivery, or other ongoing costs before deciding.

title: Connect a Note to a Next Step
teaser: Notes become clutter when their purpose is unclear.
full_text: Add one next action to an important note you make today, or clearly mark it as reference-only if no action is required.

title: Find the Shared Point in a Disagreement
teaser: Disagreement on one issue does not mean disagreement on everything.
full_text: In one difficult conversation, name a point you both accept before describing where the actual difference begins.

title: Watch a Process From Start to Finish
teaser: Improving isolated pieces can hide the real bottleneck.
full_text: Observe one repeated process all the way through today and note where the most waiting, confusion, or errors occur.

title: Measure the Time Cost of a Small Task
teaser: Minor repeated tasks can consume more time than they appear to.
full_text: Time one recurring task today and estimate its weekly total. Then decide whether it should be simplified, delegated, or automated.

title: Record an Improvement That Worked
teaser: Useful solutions can be forgotten as easily as problems.
full_text: Write down one recent change that made something easier and note why it worked. Make it repeatable if the benefit is worth keeping.

title: Verify Before You Forward
teaser: Fast sharing can spread outdated or misleading information.
full_text: Before sending an important claim to someone else, check its source, date, and context. If uncertainty remains, say so clearly.

title: Make Room for June Before It Arrives
teaser: Preparing for a new month is not only about adding more tasks.
full_text: Review what is carrying into June and remove, delay, or delegate one item that is not a real priority.

title: Close One Unfinished Task Deliberately
teaser: Not every open task deserves to be completed.
full_text: Choose one item that has stalled for a long time. If it no longer matters, cancel it intentionally instead of keeping it permanently open.

title: End the Month With a Next Step
teaser: Reflection is most useful when it informs what happens next.
full_text: Write three short notes for May: what worked, what you will stop doing, and the first concrete step you will take in June.
